visualCharacteristics.summary: Homepage banner carousel with autoplay, progress dots and per-slide desktop/mobile images and optional copy card.

contentPattern.structure: Each row is a slide: [desktop picture] [mobile picture] [optional copy cell: headings + CTA, or lone link = whole-slide link]. Class start-N / start-mobile-N sets the initial slide.

usage: Homepage banner carousel with autoplay, progress dots and per-slide desktop/mobile images and optional copy card.

suitableFor: homepage hero banners with multiple slides
